items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 42:1
items.html: BYA, from their source, are only the discernment of TNHYM, because they are the discernment of the TNHY of the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG, which, because of the ascent of the concluding Malchut to the place of the Bina of the body, went out from the Chazeh downward of this Partzuf to the discernment of empty void (as above, Item 3). Thus the source of Beriah, which is the two lower thirds of Tifferet, that is, the seven lower Sefirot of the Bina of the body, which is the discernment of YESHSUT — behold, Beriah is not attributed to the GAR of Bina, which are the upper AVI, but to the seven lower Sefirot of Bina, which are YESHSUT. (Item 204).
